rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are presidential congratulatory letters marking the establishment or anniversary of an Asian republic together with the promulgation or inauguration of its constitution. They follow the same sequence: greetings conveyed on behalf of the American people; praise for constitutional, democratic national development; reference to friendship or shared support; confidence in continued progress under the recipient's leadership; and a closing wish for success or prosperity. C23 and C18 share the Viet-Nam setting and themes of independence, anti-Communism, progress, and American support, but their purposes and structures are substantially different from the child's commemorative letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: send to you the warmest congratulations of the American people on the occasion of the first anniversary of the Republic and upon the promulgation of the Vietnamese Constitution
shared_material.parent_excerpt: On the occasion of Pakistan's establishment as a Republic within the Commonwealth, I send my greetings and best wishes, as well as those of the people of the United States
shared_material.explanation: Both open by conveying the American people's greetings to a president on an occasion centered on the establishment or anniversary of a republic.

shared_material.child_excerpt: upon the promulgation of the Vietnamese Constitution
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The inauguration of Pakistan's constitution represents an important milestone in Pakistan's development as a modern, democratic state
shared_material.explanation: The constitution is paired with the republican occasion and presented as evidence of democratic national development.

shared_material.child_excerpt: May the Vietnamese people inspired by your dedicated leadership and the high principles of their democratic institutions, enjoy long years of prosperity in justice and in peace.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am confident that under your inspiring leadership Pakistan will continue to make progress in advancing the welfare of its people. May I express my good wishes for success in these worthy endeavors.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude with near-parallel praise of the president's inspiring leadership and wishes for the country's future progress and welfare.
